messages:
Diego: Kickoff for Cygnus Pharma onboarding. Main goals: map stakeholders, agree success criteria, and lock a 30/60 day plan. Renewal flagged for 2029-Q2. Quick intros?
Pri (Cygnus): Hi all  were focused on privacy (PHI), nightly batch ingest from SFTP, and chat for clinician-facing summaries. PM is Pri.
Hannah: Ill own the ingestion pipeline and transformation. Need one redacted nightly file + sample intents. If we get the first file, I can scaffold in ~7 business days.
Leo: Platform will stand up a sandbox environment and a staging model. We need a subnet allowlist and an SFTP endpoint. Infra prep ~4 business days after allowlist.
Sofia (Security): PHI handling requires a data flow diagram and DPA + BAA. We can support Dedicated or Private for default 12m retention. Will send a security checklist.
Diego: Proposed success criteria:
- Sandbox E2E (SFTP -> embeddings -> chat) with redacted data
- SSO via Okta with 4 test users
- Staging p50 latency <360ms and p90 <800ms
- Compliance checklist & signed BAA
- KT session recorded and runbook created
Agree?
Pri (Cygnus): Agree. Also need exportable audit logs for regulators.
Sofia (Security): Exportable logs supported on Private; add-on for Hosted. Will include extraction steps in checklist.
Hannah: Small perf ask: whats the customer expectation for concurrent sessions? That drives batching config.
Pri (Cygnus): Initially ~20 concurrent clinician sessions, burst to 80. Might grow.
Diego: Risks:
- Delay getting redacted nightly file (blocks pipeline)
- SFTP credentials misconfig (blocks ingest)
- BAA/legal delays
- Model quality after quantization causing hallucinations
Action items (owner + due):
- Pri: share redacted sample file + data dictionary (due Fri)
- Hannah: ingest scaffold + mapping doc (due next Tue)
- Leo: provision sandbox + provide allowlist IPs (due Mon)
- Sofia: security checklist + BAA next steps (due Wed)
- Diego: create calendar cadence + onboarding doc (due today)
ci-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Cygnus Pharma Onboarding - Weekly" Tue 08:30 PT starting 3865002000
Hannah: Quick config snippet well need from customer:
```
SFTP_HOST=sftp.cygnus.local
SFTP_PATH=/incoming/nightly/
REDACT_FIELDS=patient_ssn,patient_email
```
Pri (Cygnus): Copy  will provision SFTP & DM creds to Hannah. Legal looped in for BAA.
Diego: Ill post the Confluence onboarding checklist and invite once the meeting is created. If anything urgent, ping me or drop in this thread. :rocket:
